Commentary.Commentary: Except for Sophie Ecclestone, the bowlers were not upto the mark for England. The lines were a bit too wayward and they failed to bowl to the field that was set for them. Now though it is onto their batters. South Africa have a really good bowling attack and this chase won't be easy. England though have a lot of quality in their batting. Can they chase it down?

That is a really good batting effort by South Africa! They have not been at their best with the bat in this tournament but this is a really good score they have put up in a knockout game. It was the openers who laid the foundation with a really good start. Both scored fifties before Laura Wolvaardt fell. Tazmin Brits continued on her merry way. However, there was a period where things slowed down a touch but Marizanne Kapp gave South Africa the finish they were looking for by playing a brilliant cameo.
FOUR! One-bounce and into the fence! That is a massive last over and SOUTH AFRICA END WITH 164! This is short and angled into the body, it is pulled over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Finds the gap! That is a brilliant shot! Everybody was up on the off side, she makes room, this is a slower one on off, it is slammed through covers for a boundary. 160 is up.
Another one on the fuller side, this is hit through covers for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Two off the Free Hit! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped over cover for two.
NO BALL AND FOUR! That has slipped out. A high full toss, this is down the leg side. Marizanne Kapp pulls it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Free Hit coming up.
Fuller and on middle, Sune Luus looks to work it on the leg side, it works through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, Sune Luus works it down to long on for one. That is a top over.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
OUT! TIMBER! Aother one bites the dust! This is way too full, Nadine de Klerk picks the wrong ball to sweep and misses and it hits the stumps.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! That is another important wicket and England finishing strongly. Shorter and on middle, this one turns away. Chloe Tryon pulls but towards deep mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Leading edge and two! Excellent running! On middle, this lands and turns away. Chloe Tryon looks to flick but it goes off the leading edge it lands safe mid off region for two.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.

OUT! TAKEN! End of a brilliant innings by Tazmin Brits, also, this could be a timely wicket and could make a difference of 10 runs to the final total. On middle, this is a little too full, this is lofted down towards long on where it is taken. The fielder is quite straight. Good placement.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Lauren Bell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Smashed! This is fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits makes room and slams it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, Marizanne Kapp looks to play the paddle scoop, it goes off the underedge towards fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, this is jammed out towards mid off for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Two more! Shorter and angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
Shorter and on middle, Kapp looks to cut but it goes off the underedge towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Misfield and four! On middle, this is lofted towards mid on. The fielder dives forward but fails to stop it and it goes between the hands and down to the long on fence.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut to point.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of mid-wicket for two.
Two mnore! Outside off, this is lofted over cover for two.
Lands safe! On off, this is hit over mid off for two.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Tazmin Brits steps out and makes room, makes it into a half volley and then plays it over cover for a boundary.
Another dot! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is defended.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Hammered away! This is turning out to be a huge over and that is also fifty for Tazmin Brits! She is in her elements now. On off, she smacks it through covers for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Over the fence again. Tazmin Brits is in some form now. She steps out again, does not quite get to the pitch of the ball but still hits it over the long on fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
SIX! BANG! Over the fence. Tazmin Brits steps out, she gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Tazmin Brits looks to sweep but misses.
The reverse sweep comes out. Tazmin Brits though finds point.
On middle, this is played over mid-wicket for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a soft dismissal and a much-needed one for the visitors. Laura Wolvaardt falls and it is one of the best bowlers in the world who gets it. This one holds in the surface and also turns a touch. On middle, this lands and spins away. Laura Wolvaardt looks to flick but this goes off the leading edge and it lobs towards point. It is taken by Charlotte Dean.
Commentary.Howout: c Charlotte Dean b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Now takes one as she plays it through point.

FOUR! Up and over! Laura Wolvaardt gets to yet another fifty! Top knock from here. She continues from where she left off in the last game. This is tossed up outside off, she hits it over cover for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, Laura Wolvaardt works it through square leg for one.
Two more! The sweep comes out, it is hit through square leg for two.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A single as this is hit down to long on.

A loud appeal but turned down! England review! NOT OUT! There is glove as Ultra Edge shows a spike. On the pads, Tazmin Brits looks to pull but it goes off the glove and onto the pads, then towards short fine leg for one. England lose a review.
Laura Wolvaardt steps out and hits it down to long on for one.
Another single as this is played through covers. Another top over for South Africa.
Another single as this is hit through covers.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
WIDE! This one is down the leg side. Laura looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Whipped away! The two have probably decided to go for it now. On middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
Lands safe again! Tazmin Brits is going for it! On middle, Tazmin Brits looks to heave it but only manages to hit it high up in the air, wide of long on for one.
Just out of reach! Fuller and on off, this is lofted towards mid off. Just over the fielder running back and two is taken.
Laura Wolvaardt steps out but fails to get to the pitch of the ball, it is played back to the bowler.
Another single as this is hit through square leg.
On off, this is worked down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single to end the over! 9 off it. On middle, Brits eases it to long on for one. South Africa Women will be happy at this stage after the start they got.
Tossed up on off, eased to long on for a single.
Brits again uses her feet and hits this full ball to long on for one.
FOUR! Shot! Full and on off. Brits dances down the track, gets inside the line of the ball and drills it to long off for four.
Flighted, outside off. Wolvaardt drives it to cover where the fielder lets it through her hands for one.
A slower short ball on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Angling on the pads. Brits fails to flick and a leg bye is taken as it rolls to fine leg.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
That has hit the square leg umpire. It was hit pretty hard! Short and outside off, pulled to square leg and it hits the umpire standing across. A single.
Full ball from wide of the crease on middle. Kept out.
Outside off and this is punched to point. A half-stop by the fielder and a single is taken.
FOUR! Wolvaardt is looking in good shape now! Too full and on middle. Wolvaardt lifts it over mid on and this one goes quickly to the fence.
Six singles of the over then! Outside off, punched past cover for one. 50 up!
Flat and on middle, turned to mid-wicket for a single.
Another single as this is driven down to long on.
Brits takes it on the full and hits it to long on for one more.
Tossed up on off, Wolvaardt comes down the track and pushes it past cover for one.
Too full and on middle. Brits plays it to deep square leg for a single.
Bowls it straight on middle, Wolvaardt whips it to long on and gets a couple of runs. 7 runs off this one now.
Wolvaardt cuts again but this time finds the fielder at point.
FOUR! These two have changed the gears now. Short and wide outside off. Wolvaardt goes back and cuts it hard past point for four.
On off, kept out.
Length ball, tailing on middle, Brits tucks it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, skids on and Brits swings and misses.
Length and on off, played back to the bowler.
Outside off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Sciver tries to surprise with a short ball but Brits saw it early and pulls it to square leg for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Wolvaardt bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Two wides! Going down leg, it is left alone. The keeper fumbles and it goes to fine leg for a single.
Slightly full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
On a length and on middle, blocked out.
Best over for the hosts so far! 14 runs off it. On off, worked to long on for one.
SIX! BANG! Turning out to be a good over for the hosts! Flighted way outside off. Wolvaardt will not miss this as she powers it over long off for a biggie.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Three more! Good running! Tad short on middle. Wolvaardt rocks back and pulls it past square leg for three runs.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a couple.
Leg bye! Flatter and angling down. Brits offers no shot and it goes off the pads to fine leg for a leg bye. England appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Might be just going down.
Fuller and outside off, Wolvaardt pushes it to point.
Tossed up on middle. Brits skips down and lofts it to long on for one more.
Flighted again, outside off, this one spins away. Brts prods to defend but misses.
FOUR! Much better! Flighted wide outside off and Brits drags it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket. Just too many dot balls already.
On middle, blocked out.
That was some delivery! Excellent bowling from England! This is full and around leg. Wolvaardt clears her front leg to heave but misses.
Length ball, outside off, Wolvaardt knocks it to cover.
Short and just going down. Brits pulls to fine leg for a single. Katherine Brunt is not happy with the delivery. She is trying something different here.
On middle, on a length, it is played to mid on. Three dots now.
Finds the fielder again! Outside off, this is hit to cover.
On a length and outside off, Brits punches and finds cover.
Yet another good over! Very full and on middle. Wolvaardt drives and Bell this time gets a hand as it rolls to mid on.
Well bowled! Bell goes very full and outside off. Wolvaardt tries to drive but fails to hit it cleanly.
Leg bye! On the thigh pads, Brits misses her flick and it rolls off the pads to fine leg for a run.
Wide! Short and wide outside off. Left alone for a wide.
Full and on middle. Brits goes straight and hits the other side of the stumps. No run.
That was swinging down! Length ball on middle. Brits misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but that was moving too much.
Brits is underway! A length ball, outside off, Brits punches it in the gap to covers for two runs.
Lauren Bell to bowl from the other end.
Excellent comeback! Four dots to end the over, Around off, pushed to covers.
Since going for that boundary, Brunt is targeting the stumps. On middle, defended out.
This is full and on middle, Wolvaardt strokes it to mid on.
Goes full now, around off, Wolvaardt drives it to cover.
FOUR! Punished! South Africa Women are underway! Short, wide outside off and Wolvaardt cuts it past point and it races into the fence.
Brunt serves a length ball, outside off. Wolvaardt punches it to covers.

We are set. The teams are out for the national anthems. It will be England's first followed by the hosts. It is time for action. The English players are out in the middle. Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits to open for South Africa. The players take a knee before the start of the game. Katherine Brunt to bowl first! Let's play...
PITCH REPORT - Katie Martin says it is the same wicket as the first Semi-Final. Adds it is a bit dry. Hard-length deliveries will be go to for the seamers and it will spin a bit.

England Women (Playing XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Sophie Ecclestone, Katherine Brunt, Sarah Glenn, Charlotte Dean, Lauren Bell (In for Freya Davies).

South Africa Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Anne Bosch, Nadine de Klerk, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.

Heather Knight says they would have batted as well. Adds the pitch is slightly on the dry side. Informs they have made one change. Lauren Bell comes in. Reckons the mentality is the same despite which team they are playing. Shares her players are used to the crowd and hopes the fans support their team.
Sune Luus says it is a good wicket and would like to put runs on board. Informs they are playing the same team. Adds it is going to be a good match-up and they are ready for the challenge.
TOSS - South Africa Women have won the toss and will BAT first!

The money is on England to win but South Africa have earned their place as well. The hosts lost their first match but with better net run rate redeemed themselves. It will not be easy for them but they have the home support. Can they go one step further or it will be an easy win for England? Toss coming up.

We are yet to get over from the first Semi-Final and we are already here for the second one. Hello everyone, it's time for England to take on South Africa for the place in finals. Australia and England are two teams who were favourites. Both were unbeaten in the group stages, Australia have reached the final destination. Will the heavens meet for England to book their place.
...Match Day...

The 2nd semi-final of the 2023 ICC Women's T20 World Cup is upon us, which sees England Women take on South Africa Women at the Newlands in Cape Town. England Women advanced to the semi-finals after topping Group 2 with four wins from as many games, whereas South Africa Women were level on four points with New Zealand and Sri Lanka in Group 1 but qualified for the semi-finals in second place courtesy of a superior net run rate. England Women are in a brilliant run of form heading into the semi-finals with four wins on the trot. Natalie Sciver has been their standout batter, and she, along with Danni Wyatt and Heather Knight, will be crucial to their team's chances. In the bowling department, the duo of Sophie Ecclestone and Sarah Glenn has starred for them so far, and the duo will require support from the likes of Katherine Brunt and Charlotte Dean in this game. Their opponents, South Africa Women, had a nervy start to their campaign but bounced back, winning two out of the next three games to qualify for the semi-finals. Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits have done the bulk of the scoring for the hosts in their four games. Marizanne Kapp and Sune Luus have been below par with the bat, and the hosts will need these two to step up in this important fixture. However, the experienced Marizanne Kapp has performed well with the ball and leads the wicket-taking charts for them with 7 scalps. South Africa Women will also be dependent on Shabnim Ismail and Nonkululeko Mlaba to deliver the goods with the ball. Out of the last five T20I meetings between these two sides, England Women have emerged victorious on four occasions, and as a result, they hold the upper hand heading into this fixture. Who will become the second team to reach the final of the 2023 ICC Women's T20 World Cup? We shall find out together.
